info.title: DotMX Exchange API
info.description:
High-performance perpetual futures exchange with Binance-style fee structure.

## Features

- **Maker Rebates**: Earn -0.005% to -0.025% rebates as a maker
- **Taker Fees**: Pay 0.015% to 0.035% as a taker
- **Funding Fees**: 8-hour interval, peer-to-peer funding mechanism
- **Liquidation**: 0.4% penalty with progressive liquidation
- **10 VIP Tiers**: Volume-based fee discounts up to 50%
- **DMX Token**: 25% discount on taker fees

## Rate Limits

- Public endpoints: 1200 requests/minute
- Authenticated endpoints: 2400 requests/minute
- Order placement: 100 orders/second

## WebSocket Feeds

- Market data: `ws://api.dotmx.xyz/ws/market`
- User updates: `ws://api.dotmx.xyz/ws/user`

## Authentication

Use Bearer token in Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

Submit a new buy or sell order to the matching engine.

## Order Types

- **LIMIT**: Order with a specific price
- **MARKET**: Order executed at best available price

## Time in Force

- **GTC**: Good Till Cancel (default)
- **IOC**: Immediate or Cancel
- **FOK**: Fill or Kill
